title: Handling malformed or inconsistent JSON
goal: Use try...catch to handle JSON.parse exceptions and check the parsing results.
summary: import function accepts JSON text. Only accepts array data, other formats return an empty list.
tasks: completes readChecklist(text), converting JSON text that can be parsed into an array into an array.
[] is returned when the JSON is corrupted or the parsed result is not an array.

example.note: JSON.parse will throw an exception if it fails to parse. Successful parsing only means that the format is valid, and the data type can also be checked.

hint: Write JSON.parse in try. Use Array.isArray to distinguish arrays from other JSON values.
